steps.text: On a volunteer family's page, each card at the top is one role. A card with a person's name is that person's own role.
Click a card to open its details. Remove Role and Complete Other here apply only to Leia.
Complete Other lets you record any action for Leia, even one this role doesn't list. Search for it and pick it.
Then choose Complete or Exempt, and fill in the details as you would for any requirement.
To take Leia out of this role, click Remove Role. Choose a reason, and explain why in the comments.
Click Remove Role and confirm. The rest of the family keeps their roles.
Roles that belong to the whole family, like Host Family, are removed from the menu at the top right.
Complete other in this menu records an action for the family as a whole.
